purpose: Additive AMBIENT-002 ownership, memory, perception and authoring retrieval questions; predecessor fixtures unchanged.

questions.query: How does AMBIENT-002 living inhabitant memory invalidate when a World generation changes or becomes unavailable?
facts: World identity is copied from accepted owner snapshots even when material sensing is disabled.
Run, epoch, actor and World generation bind private knowledge; unavailable generation is not a new World.
Authored save does not serialize ephemeral spatial memory.

questions.query: What is the bounded adaptive near-field material sensing budget and what does incomplete sampled coverage mean?
facts: Adaptive sensing admits at most 4096 unique native material ID reads, eight materials and radius96.
Requested spacing may coarsen explicitly; nearest observed does not guarantee nearest native cell.
Stale, unavailable, observed absence and incomplete coverage remain distinct.

questions.query: Does group Apply atomically assign an ambient profile and preserve live Rapier actors when one selected actor is stale or incompatible?
facts: Every captured actor identity/control is preflighted before any producer is revoked.
All replacements are visible before cancellation notices; a bad member refuses the whole group.
Successful group assignment preserves physical bodies, poses and resources.

questions.query: How are scene-local shared profiles, individual overrides and authored home regions saved and reused?
facts: The ambient_authoring library has at most32 validated profiles.
Selecting stages a copy and applying creates explicit per-actor overrides; library changes do not propagate implicitly.
Regions and assignments persist with authored configuration; drives, timers and memory restart.

questions.query: Can AMBIENT-002 use 16 or32 real physical inhabitants or read every other actor private memory?
facts: The authoritative host remains eight logical actors; unaccepted762 is not imported.
Only copied poses, velocities, capabilities and authored tags are shared.
Bounded32 candidate observations is a future perception seam, not physical capacity.

questions.query: Do local terrain rays give an ambient flyer or wheel a global route or a swept-volume clearance guarantee?
facts: Ground/wheel receives two horizontal rays and flight eight radial rays beyond the hull.
Center-line observations do not prove swept-volume clearance or global reachability.
